name: IETF/RFC Process
description: The standards process for security-related RFCs (TLS, IPsec, S/MIME). Authors explicitly named on every RFC, with contributors and acknowledgments sections providing permanent traceability.

peerReview.processDescription: Authors explicitly named on every RFC (up to 5). Contributors listed in Contributors section. Acknowledgments section thanks reviewers and working group members. Working group membership documented in RFC metadata.

attribution.attributionNotes: All RFCs are public. IETF Datatracker provides complete traceability. Author and contributor names are permanent parts of the published RFC.

povsAlignment.description: Peer review / audit through consensus-based standards process with permanent author traceability.
